name: gyroscopic_octave_system
title: Gyroscopic Precession & Prolate-to-Sphere-to-Oblate Evolution
description: Nine gyroscopic locking stages along the octave wave arch showing axis precession from 0° through 90° (True Sphere at Wave Amplitude 4±) to 180° and spheroid morphogenesis from prolate winding to oblate ring ejection.
